copy.headline: 2 pets die, 1 rescued as Fort Worth firefighters respond to multiple fires amid cold weather
copy.caption:
Between Tuesday and Wednesday, crews with the Fort Worth Fire Department responded to 24 structure fires. The incidents included 8 residential fires, 8 mutual aid calls, 6 apartment fires, and 2 commercial fires.

No people reported injuries in the fires, officials said. However, one family dog and one family cat did not survive.

story.title: 2 pets die, 1 rescued as Fort Worth firefighters respond to multiple fires amid cold weather
story.summary: With cold weather arriving and people using their kitchens more this week, Fort Worth fire officials are reminding residents to take extra precautions at home. FORT WORTH, Texas - Between Tuesday and Wednesday, crews with the Fort Worth Fire Department responded to 24 structure fires. The incidents included 8 residential fires, 8 mutual aid calls, 6 apartment fires, and 2 commercial fires. No people reported injuries in the fires, officials said. However, one family dog and one family cat did not survive. Firefighters rescued another dog, which is doing okay, the department said. With cold weather arriving and people using their kitchens more this week, Fort Worth fire officials are reminding residents to take extra precautions at home.
